title: Financial Analysis: BYD vs. Tesla
paragraphs: BYD reported a revenue increase of 3.97% year-over-year to 124.94B CNY in March 2024. Net income rose by 10.62% to 4.57B CNY, driven by strong sales of NEVs such as Seagull and Seal. The company's EPS improved by 5.14% to 1.29 CNY, while EBITDA surged by 45.78% to 15.09B CNY, indicating operational efficiency.â�8d
